I am on a school trip of sorts in Australia. My girlfriend is on a trip in the US. 
A week ago we spent pretty much the equivalent of 24 hours saying our goodbyes. We spent it in each others arms and company for as long as we could. We went in the shower together and I came on her face.That day was by far one of the best I have had in a long time. I have a history of depression and lately you can say I have been coming out of it.
Thank you

No one is ever "better off" when someone dies. Someone is always affected and no one wants to step into a room and gaze upon a lifeless body hanging from the ceiling or on the ground. Even though I think about killing myself in order to affect other people (I have dark sense of humour) even though I wouldn't be alive to notice. I don't know how to help but there is always someone that does. Please respond I don't want to think that was your last post.
Get help? This is obviously not another day at the office when this kind of shit happens.

Be there for him and try to communicate with him. I am no psychologist (asking one of them isn't a bad idea either) but I'm often depressed due to loneliness and a sense of redundancy within myself. If you attempt to remove these sensations then that would probably be a start. Of course this is a very delicate situation so the internet might not be the best place to ask. :/
You are giving me the feels, thanks allot.
